# Step - has_not

`has_not` · `hasNot` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps elements that do not have the given property.

## Forms

```text
has_not(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_not("age").values("name").to_list()   // ["lop", "ripple"]
```
